Priya: Heads-up
Customer: Meridian Therapeutics security review tomorrow 11:00 PT. They emailed three asks: 1) RBAC change artifacts including an auditable "reason" field tied to ticket IDs, 2) KMS/HSM attestation and key provenance for their private deployment pilot, 3) an export sample for Splunk ingestion with TLS cert fingerprint. Can we assemble a focused packet and short talking points?
Daniel: I can generate the RBAC export. Meridian requested scoped changes only (service accounts + infra-admin roles) for March-May. Which retention window? They want "recent changes" plus proof that we log justification.
Priya: Ask gave "latest 90 days plus any current pending changes". Also they said they need to map our audit fields to their ticket id field. Please ensure we include a `ticket_id` or `change_ref` field if present.
Tess: I'll update the runbook for what we're allowed to share. Note: for private deployments we may need customer permission before sharing HSM attestation PDFs. I'll add language: "Attestation artifacts can be shared under NDA; provide baseline redacted sample for call."
evidence-bot: Snapshot created: /evidence/meridian/snap_1789991111.tar.gz (manifest: /evidence/meridian/manifest-1789991111.json)
Daniel: CLI I used:
```
redwoodctl audit export --tenant meridian --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-06-30 --filter "rbac,service_accounts" --fields ts,actor,action,role,change_ref,justification,request_id --format ndjson --output meridian_rbac_202603-202606.ndjson
```
Daniel: sample ndjson line (redacted):
```
{"ts":"2026-05-12T09:14:22Z","actor":"svc-deploy-meridian","action":"update-role","role":"inference-executor","change_ref":"TICKET-4321","justification":"enable batch infer for campaign X","request_id":"req_4f2a"}
```
Priya: Good. Ensure `justification` is there; Meridian will crosswalk `change_ref`. Also include a short CSV mapping header doc for their compliance team.
Omar: For KMS: hosted keys - we can provide key creation events + wrapping key ids. For private HSM: we have an attestation flow: ops runs `hsm-attest --host <node>` and we capture signed blob plus PCRs. Ops needs to run this in their private network or provide a signed copy. Can we offer a live attestation during the call (screen-share) if they want?
Tess: That seems reasonable. Also mention key provenance: creation_ts, creator_principal, origin (hsm|kms), and wrapping_key_id. We'll include an example key-event in the bundle.
Daniel: Example key event: 
```
{"ts":"2026-04-02T03:21:10Z","event":"key_create","key_id":"wrapping-key-01","origin":"cloud-kms","creator":"sys:kms-service","algorithm":"A256GCMKW","request_id":"req_7c9e"}
```
Omar: For HSM attestation, sample ops command: `hsm-attest --output attestation-1789991111.p7b --host node-3` and note that the resulting attestation contains firmware version, vendor cert chain, and signed PCR values. We'll attach a redacted attestation PDF placeholder.
Priya: Meridian asked about TLS fingerprint for Splunk HEC. We should supply the certificate sha256 fingerprint and an example event. Daniel 

Daniel: Splunk HEC sample config (redacted):
```
# outputs.conf example
[httpout:meridian_splunk]
server = splunk-hec.meridian.example:8088
sslVerifyServerCert = true
sslCA = /etc/ssl/certs/meridian-ca.pem
cert_fingerprint = sha256:3a:bf:1c:...:ef
hec_token = REDACTED
```
Daniel: Example event envelope: `{ "event": {"source":"redwood.audit","type":"rbac_change","details":{...}},"time":1654056723,"host":"redwood-01" }`
Omar: There's also a vulnerability question on the call. Meridian mentioned CVE-2026-1234 in fastloader. Status: hosted patched in 2026-05-15 maintenance window (fastloader v1.2.3). For Dedicated/Private we can provide patched images + upgrade playbook. We'll include the CVE triage note and canary logs.
Tess: Templated language for the call: "Hosted: we've rolled the patch and verified via runtime checks; Dedicated/Private: we provide a tested patched image and step-by-step upgrade playbook; customers can schedule assisted upgrades."
Priya: Action items & owners: 1) Daniel: produce RBAC export + CSV mapping doc + Splunk fingerprint sample (ETA 2h) 2) Omar: prepare HSM attestation template + key provenance examples (ETA 4h) 3) Tess: assemble runbook + NDA-friendly attestation placeholder + slide bullet points (ETA 3h) 4) Priya: dry-run 30m before call (ETA 30m).
Daniel: I'll drop the NDJSON export in /evidence/meridian/ and attach parsed CSV. Will sanitize hostnames and IPs.
evidence-bot: Evidence bundle: /evidence/meridian/bundle_1789991111.tar.gz (contents: meridian_rbac_202603-202606.ndjson, splunk_config_example.txt, hsm_attestation_sample.pdf.redacted, cve-2026-1234-triage.md)
Priya: Thanks all. If Meridian wants deeper proofs (HSM cert chain or full attestation), we'll coordinate legal/ops. Dry-run in 25 minutes. :white_check_mark:
